appearance_facts.fact: A solid blue line with circular markers traverses the plot from the upper-left to the lower-right.
The y-axis is inverted; the label '0' is at the top of the scale, and the value '8000' is at the bottom.
The line begins near the top of the chart (near the 0 mark) and descends steeply toward the bottom of the chart (near the 8000 mark).
A light purple/blue shaded region fills the area beneath the line, extending down to the bottom of the plot area.
The line reaches its lowest visual position on the page at the final data point on the far right.

printed_facts.fact: Title reads: 'Month vs. Number of COVID-19 patients hospitalized'.
Vertical axis is labeled 'Count' with tick marks at 0, 2000, 4000, 6000, and 8000.
Horizontal axis is labeled 'Month' with dates ranging from 'Feb 24, 2020' to 'Mar 14, 2020'.
The date labels are rotated approximately 45 degrees.

public_definitions: Surge-capacity planning: for rapidly increasing COVID-19 inpatient demand.
Step-down recovery planning: for easing COVID-19 inpatient demand.
Routine respiratory surveillance: for background monitoring.
uncertain: The y-axis is inverted (0 at top, 8000 at bottom), which makes the visual 'downward' slope represent an increase in the number of patients.
Specific numerical values for the start and end points are not explicitly labeled on the markers, though the start is near 0 and the end is near 8000.
